title: Strut Replacement
summary: Strut blueprint for confirming ride-control failure, mount noise, tire wear, and alignment context before quoting replacement.
symptoms: Bouncy ride, nose dive, or poor body control
Clunk, creak, or pop from the strut or upper mount area
Cupped tire wear or uneven tire contact
Fluid leakage, damaged strut body, or broken spring seat
inspect_first: Strut leakage, shaft condition, spring seat, and dust boot condition
Upper mount, bearing plate, and isolator noise while steering and over bumps
Coil spring cracks, tire wear pattern, and ride height side-to-side
Sway links, control arms, ball joints, and tie rods before assigning the noise to the strut
likely_causes: Failed upper strut mount or bearing
Broken spring or damaged spring seat
Loose sway link or control arm noise imitating strut noise
repair_overview: Confirm strut failure and inspect related mount, spring, and link components before pricing.
Support the vehicle, remove the wheel, and disconnect brake hose brackets, ABS wiring clips, and sway link as required.
Remove strut-to-knuckle and upper mount fasteners while supporting the knuckle.
Install complete strut assembly or safely transfer spring/mount components with proper compression equipment.
Torque fasteners, verify hose and wiring routing, then recommend alignment and road test.
common_mistakes: Replacing struts for a clunk caused by sway links or control arm bushings
Ignoring upper mounts, bearings, or broken springs during the estimate
Letting the knuckle hang and stressing brake hoses or axle joints
Skipping alignment after strut-to-knuckle geometry is disturbed
estimate_guidance: Quote pair replacement when ride-control balance or customer expectation supports it.
Separate complete strut assembly pricing from cartridge or mount-only service.
Add alignment recommendation for most front strut replacements.
Flag seized lower bolts, damaged mounts, and spring transfer requirements as labor variables.

recommended_repairs.title: Strut Mount Replacement
recommended_repairs.description: Commonly bundled when the upper mount or bearing is noisy or worn.

recommended_repairs.title: Sway Bar Link Replacement
recommended_repairs.description: Often disconnected during strut work and commonly mistaken for strut clunk.

recommended_repairs.title: Wheel Alignment
recommended_repairs.description: Recommended after strut replacement when camber or toe can change.

diagnostic_context.intro: Strut replacement estimates should include ride-control evidence, mount inspection, and alignment planning.
